title: Bundled normalized integral smooth adjunction presentation
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Z,Y$, an open immersion $j:X\to Z$, a proper map $p:Z\to Y$, a quasi-compact compactifiable composite $pj$ and $d\in\mathbf N$. Use the coefficient integers of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], completed integral constructible categories of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and the strict tower adjunction and its normalized integral purity realization of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection]. Define Presentation to bundle the tower base, operations, coordinates, Tate twist datum, reductions and normalized equivalences on X and Y, the tower compact-support preservation proof, tower right adjoint and adjunction, its level comparisons, and exactly the existing normalized integral Realization with those arguments. This is a type of supplied data, with no inhabitance asserted. For such a presentation, P is the actual completed compactification support restricted to integral constructibles, J is the total-limit tower right adjoint, H is completed derived pullback, tensor by the degree-zero Tate line d and shift by 2d, and gammaComponent is the specified reconstruction-unit/total-limit/source-comparison/entire-tower-gamma composite in the integral realization, using the operations and twists of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. No new functor, coefficient ring or purity map is chosen. Also define its condensed realization coordinates: transport from completed modules by the recorded coefficient isomorphism and the existing section/internal equivalence, then total derived extension along the actual continuous valuation-ring inclusion. Use the actual continuous-function field ring, its compactification support, its derived pullback, tensor by the realized integral Tate line and shift. Endpoints is the type of pairs of natural endpoint isomorphisms between these actual functors. HomComparisons is the type of natural-position linear Hom equivalences from raw localized Homs to these realized Homs normalized to the actual realization on integral arrows; no existence of either data type is asserted. The Hom scalar action is the constant-section action transported through the existing universe-polymorphic continuous module encoding. These are the coordinates of [det-sp-rational-localized-hom] and the separately derived compactification composite of [det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower], not equalities between raw and condensed categories.
